name: Stožec (Czechia)
description: White field with a green triangle at the hoist bearing a yellow fleur-de-lis, from whose point run a red stripe to the upper fly and a blue stripe to the lower fly in a Y shape, with a red rose in the upper fly and the lower fly.
history: Czech municipal flags are granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
